olivia_csm: Quick heads-up: regression affecting VPC onboarding token refresh for tenants created in the last 48h. Seeing stalled onboarding flows in trials. Drafting customer comms and need approval for credits + enablement offers. Incident INC-2025-872. @jamal_support @steve_eng can you confirm root cause and ETA?
jamal_support: Repro confirmed. 401 returned when refresh_window == 0 due to a bounds check in the refresh handler. Log sample: `auth.refresh tenant=tn-402 status=401 window=0`. Repro steps: create tenant -> trigger refresh -> 401 at /v1/auth/refresh.
steve_eng: Root cause acknowledged. Plan: revert the problematic check, add unit+integration tests for boundary conditions. Canary deploy in us-west-2 at 08:40 UTC, monitor 15m, then full rollout target 09:15 UTC. Will update statuspage after canary is healthy.
incident-bot: INC-2025-872 | created | severity: high | impacted: ~37 new trial VPC tenants | status: investigating
liam_csm: Query shows 9 impacted tenants expire within 30 days; 4 flagged high-touch (renewal-risk). We should prioritize outreach for those 9 and escalate the 4.
olivia_csm: Draft short customer note for trials: "Hi — we're investigating an authentication issue that is preventing onboarding for some new VPC tenants created in the last 48 hours. Engineers are deploying a fix and we expect service restored within ~60 minutes. For affected trials we'll apply a one-week platform credit and offer a 1:1 enablement session. We apologize for the inconvenience. — Olivia, Redwood CSM"
jamal_support: Suggest adding a simple workaround: re-run the onboarding job with a short retry delay or rotate the onboarding token via Console. Sanitized curl to retry:```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/onboard/retry
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tn-402"}'
```
steve_eng: Ops alternative: flip internal per-tenant flag to relax refresh enforcement temporarily while fix rolls. @sam_ops can you enable for the impacted cohort? If enabled we can send the blast immediately and reduce support load.
sam_ops: Enabling the relax-refresh flag for the cohort now. Monitoring auth error rate and success count for next 30m; will report metrics here. Paste the 9 near-expiry tenant IDs if you want them prioritized.
olivia_csm: Sending the 9 tenant IDs via DM to Sam. Preparing two outreach templates: short trial note (above) and an exec-level message for renewal-risk accounts. Exec draft: "Hello — we are reaching out proactively. During onboarding some VPC trial tenants experienced intermittent authentication failures; engineers are deploying a fix and we expect full availability shortly. To mitigate impact we will: (1) apply a one-week usage credit, (2) schedule a 1:1 enablement session within 3 business days, and (3) assign a CS lead for priority coordination. We will follow up with an RCA and a short impact survey. Please reply with preferred times for a 30-min call. — Olivia"
liam_csm: LGTM. For execs add a line about next steps for renewal discussions and include the survey link to capture business impact. I will take point on the 4 high-touch accounts after initial outreach.
maria_finance: Finance ack: one-week goodwill credits are approved for this cohort. Please tag affected invoices for tracking.
olivia_csm: Thanks. Final plan: wait for Sam to confirm flag flip and for Steve to confirm canary healthy; then send trial blast and exec notes for prioritized list. We'll include a concise technical RCA in the follow-up: "Cause: an off-by-one bounds check in refresh handling caused valid refreshes to be rejected." Steve will publish an ops postmortem and link it in the follow-up.
jamal_support: After rollback we'll provide a short support response template and a step-by-step workaround for customers needing immediate help.
steve_eng: Targeting statuspage update and CS thread follow-up after full rollout verification (~09:30 UTC).
olivia_csm: Great — I'll queue messages and schedule 1:1s for responders. Posting here after messages go out. Thanks everyone.
